description: Launch one or more GPU cloud instances. COSTS MONEY: billing starts as soon as the instance boots (hourly rate per instance_type). Pick region_name + instance_type_name from lambda_list_instance_types (only regions with capacity available), and pass exactly one existing SSH key name in ssh_key_names (create keys in the Lambda dashboard). Lambda Cloud REST: POST /api/v1/instance-operations/launch.

file_system_names.description: Names of existing persistent filesystems to attach.

hostname.description: Custom hostname (1-63 chars, lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens, pattern ^[a-z0-9][0-9a-z-]{0,62}$).

image_family.description: Image family to boot (latest in family). Mutually exclusive with image_id.

image_id.description: Specific image id to boot (from lambda_list_images). Mutually exclusive with image_family.

instance_type_name.description: Instance type to launch (e.g. 'gpu_1x_a100') — from lambda_list_instance_types.

name.description: A friendly name for the instance (max 64 chars).

quantity.description: How many instances to launch (default 1). EACH one is billed separately.

region_name.description: Region to launch in (e.g. 'us-east-1') — must have capacity for the type.

ssh_key_names.description: Names of SSH keys to install (exactly one supported). The key must already exist in your account.

tags.description: Key/value tags to attach to the instance.

user_data.description: cloud-init user-data script to run on first boot (max 1MB).

name: lambda_launch_instance
title: Launch instance
